entity_raw.definition_raw:
You know that the keys to victory are sudden attacks and even more sudden retreats.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +1, kobold.

Benefit(s): When you’re adjacent to an ally who also has this feat at the beginning of a surprise round, and both you and that ally can act during that surprise round, you can take both a standard action and a move action during that surprise round.

Normal: You can take only a standard action or a move action during a surprise round.
